prompt: A clean, straight-on printed decorative panel titled 'TILE MOTIF PANEL' (Point-symmetric letter grid): an 7x7 square grid of printed CAPITAL LETTERS, one letter per cell, with a small centre dot. Draw the square grid large and centred so it fills the central area of the sheet, with straight evenly-spaced ruled rows and columns viewed perfectly straight-on. CRITICAL symmetry rule: the grid has 180-degree rotational (point) symmetry about its centre -- the letter in any cell equals the letter in the diametrically opposite cell (the cell you reach by rotating the grid half a turn). So the letter at row 2 column 3 equals the letter at row 6 column 5, and the letter at row 1 column 6 equals the letter at row 7 column 2 (rows and columns counted from 1 at the top-left). Render it on plain white paper in portrait orientation with thin black ruled lines and a bold black header, like a clean office printout, photographed straight-on.
